title: Civilization
statusNote: Logos, main menu, a quick-start game on Chieftain: the world map loads, the settler moves, founds Rome and the city screen opens. Turns end and the game menu, minimap and tactical map work.
notes: A new game opens with an introduction and the game's own controls list; close both with the right soft key.
When a city is founded its name appears in a plain text box on a black screen. The left soft key accepts the suggested name.
The main menu starts a demo when left idle for about half a minute; any key returns to the menu.

controls.source: The game's own Game Controls list, shown when a new game starts (number keys, star, hash, both soft keys). The d-pad, OK and the soft key labels in dialogs were observed in play.

actions.up: Move the map cursor; move through menus
actions.down: Move the map cursor; move through menus
actions.ok: Select; open the city or unit under the cursor
actions.lsk: Game menu (Game, Kingdom, Advisors, Space race, Civilopedia, Help); Select
actions.rsk: Skip unit turn, end of turn; Close or Back in dialogs
actions.5: Unit orders; in terrain cursor mode, terrain info or pick the unit or city
actions.0: Cursor mode selector (active unit, all units, city, terrain)

notes: In the game menu a number key jumps to the entry with that number.

On a gamepad Y opens the cursor mode selector, X is 5, the right stick moves the unit or cursor (2, 4, 6, 8) and the back buttons open the minimap and the tactical map. The diagonal moves (1, 3, 7, 9) need the keyboard.
